purpose: Descriptive, read-only separation of per-horizon student/teacher rollout discrepancy from sensitivity of the official LeWM objective on the existing 93 student-generated train banks.

source.allowed_split: train only; validation and reserved holdout banks must not be opened

models.student_identity: LeWMCompactRecurrentTransitionStudent h256; cem_distribution_distill treatment; 1000 extra updates

method.prediction: Reuse the frozen partial-horizon runner's official teacher targets, h256 student rollout, loader, and objective; recompute only k0 student and k5 teacher controls on the saved candidate arrays.
method.latent_discrepancy: For each bank and horizon h=1..5, mean squared student-teacher latent difference over all 300 candidates and 192 dimensions divided by max(mean squared teacher latent over the same elements, 1e-8); aggregate bank values within episode.
method.counterfactual: For each h independently, replace only student prediction[:,h,:] with teacher prediction[:,h,:], score the mixed sequence with the same official objective, and compare with the full-student scorer. This mixed sequence is not a physically consistent rollout.
method.score_perturbation: Per bank and h, RMS(counterfactual_cost-student_cost) / max(population_std(saved teacher_costs), 1e-6).
method.ranking_metrics: Use pinned torch.topk(cost,k=30,largest=False,sorted=True); standardized teacher-elite regret and Top30 recall are relative to saved teacher costs/top30.
method.strata: Report replan t0/t25 and CEM rounds 10/20/30 separately. Episode is the unit; aggregate available banks within each episode before summaries. Episode 15946 has no t25 bank and stays missing.
method.interpretation: Descriptive only: report horizon-wise episode summaries and sign counts for h5 versus h1; report per-horizon episode-median regret/recall changes and score perturbation. No p-values, GO gate, training, CEM, planner, or closed-loop authorization. Official teacher predictions are a reference, not ground truth; this diagnoses objective sensitivity to latent swaps, not criterion correctness.

validity.cost_control: Before any diagnostic metric is computed or written, recomputed k0 student and k5 teacher costs must each match all 93 corresponding saved costs.
validity.failure_action: Fail closed on any provenance, bank identity, coverage, shape, finite, or cost-alignment mismatch; preserve no partial metric summary.

execution.allocation: One guarded PBS GPU compute-node job; never run model or bank I/O on a login node.
execution.data_handling: Read only the existing train_banks.pt and frozen checkpoints; do not collect episodes, train, or read validation/holdout banks.
